title: [AB#647643] Retain remote files and safely retire verified local references
summary: Follow-up to the external storage retention fix that was already merged in #11733. Adds regression tests for quote posting, Copy/Move and retirement guards, updates the configuration guidance, shows retention status on the Document Attachment - External page, and removes unused deletion telemetry.
key_points: The core logic that keeps remote files and safely retires local references was already merged in #11733
Adds a retention-status display to the Document Attachment - External page
Adds regression tests for quote to order posting, Copy/Move with byte checks, and retirement guards
Removes unused deletion telemetry and updates the README configuration guidance
Trade-off: remote files are kept even when unshared, so storage use can grow
quote: The accepted fix retains remote files instead of deleting them.
